steps: Install the Fetch app and create a free account.
Snap a photo of any grocery, gas, restaurant, or retail receipt in the app (or connect email/Walmart accounts for e-receipts).
Earn at least 25 points per receipt; check the app for bonus brand offers before shopping to stack points.
Repeat daily — points accumulate per receipt.
Redeem points for gift cards (Amazon, Target, Walmart, Starbucks, etc.) starting at 3,000 points ($3).
timing: Points credit after each receipt scan; redeem for gift cards once your balance reaches the minimum (3,000 points = $3).
